messages.message:
To start a return, share your order number, the item you want to return, and your reason for the return. Your request will be checked to ensure it is within the 30-day window, and then a return will be created for you with a reference number. (Source: How do I start a return?)

Would you like help starting your return now? If so, please provide your order number, the item, and your reason for returning it.
